note: Deno.serve ORIGIN secondary dialect deferred (D6442/D6447 / D6522). Not cheap on javascript-ast-ingest: Deno.serve has no Bun-like `routes` object (open Deno serve-router request; docs route via pathname/method switch, URLPattern, or @std/http route). D6510 already lists method+path switch-only servers as Bun.serve honest holes — peeling Deno.serve would require a new control-flow peel suite (if/else + switch + URLPattern.exec + pathname.split + @std/http route tables), not peel-reuse of Bun routes-object / Oak router.get|post / itty Router. Probe: astRouteCount 0 on Deno.serve(handler) + pathname/method + URLPattern (current peels only see Bun.serve({ routes }) + framework routers). Express/TS remain D6448-ST; Oak (G10043) / Bun.serve (G10048) / itty (G10047) stay green. Do not invent Deno.serve({ routes }) or a switch-to-CWL control-flow invent.
